shared_results_visibility.decision: Keep all job status rows current-conversation only. Provide approved shared media as a distinct optional shared_results projection using chat_sessions.take_visible and latest explicit approved Take review.
shared_results_visibility.reason: A shared approved asset does not authorize disclosing another conversation job/history. Store.state currently filters jobs by owner even when approved Takes are shared.

product_write_set: production_context.py helper current_work_status + read result field only
tests_write_set: new focused test for work status projection and HTTP context consent; parent coordinates file ownership
minimal_recommendation.ordering_limit: Hard cap8 items plus truncation metadata. Generalchat/action rows have no comparable created timestamp, so do not claim global newest8 from merged rowids. For smallest read-only patch expose source group ordering with explicit per-source recent insertion semantics and deterministic capped interleaving; alternatively add new-record timestamps as a separately scoped change and mark legacy chronology unknown. Keep counts/truncated transparent so older active work is not silently treated as nonexistent.
minimal_recommendation.query_semantics: Existing search_project_context receives this bounded metadata. Its answer must say observed status as of this lookup and requery when user requests current status. Status receipt is not an execution grant or a completed result.

freshness_and_self_stale.observation: snapshot hash includes settings/canonical context/shot selected+revision, not DB job state. Do not add work_status to stored p or snapshot.

local job progress/state updates only jobs rows and their revision; do not rewrite state project for read summary. These updates should not invalidate canonical approval solely because status changed.

binding revalidates canonical model/context/rights/settings and exact approved body; music_context has its special freshness marker. Do not apply an always-current work_status hash marker: self queued→running or progress changes would stale its own approved continuation.

freshness_and_self_stale.source: production_tools.py:61–68 snapshot verification; production_tools.py:77 search result
freshness_and_self_stale.observation: Query status is an immutable observation in persisted tool result/continuation consent. Future state changes do not rewrite old results; display as-of timestamp. Any later effect must revalidate its own exact target/version/rights/approval.

Importing a new Take increments project/shot revision and shared state. Result creation may legitimately stale previous canonical execution context; do not exclude this just to keep status chats running.

required_verification_not_run: Two projects, two conversations; sibling pending/error/prompt/grant not disclosed; explicitly approved shared Take limited metadata only
Synthetic local render/motion/3D/provider/general chat statuses preserve exact state and execution mode; malformed missing progress/revision timestamps stay null
All <=8 plus truncation/ordering facts; no invented global latest chronology
Key/path/private prompt sentinel values never appear in serialized projection; raw errors not returned
Actual loopback HTTP search→tool result→separate continuation consent persists snapshot; DB progress changes do not trigger self-stale; canonical version/rights/model change still blocks effects
Reopen/restart preserves job IDs/status evidence and unknown/cancel semantics; no retry or cost mutation from query
No people count/presence without identity store; output approval remains distinct from completed/result-approved
implementation_status: plan only; parent backend agent currently writing shared files; do not apply concurrent source edits
